user_text: Summarize the benefits of code review for a small team.
assistant_text:
# Benefits of Code Review for a Small Team

## Quality & Reliability
- **Catches bugs early** before they reach production
- **Enforces coding standards** and consistency across the codebase
- **Reduces technical debt** by encouraging cleaner solutions upfront

## Knowledge Sharing
- **Spreads context** so no single person is the only one who understands a feature
- **Reduces bus factor** — the team isn't dependent on one developer
- **Mentors junior developers** through direct, practical feedback

## Team Collaboration
- **Builds shared ownership** of the codebase
- **Encourages discussion** about design decisions and trade-offs
- **Aligns the team** on architecture and best practices

## Practical Advantages for Small Teams
| Benefit | Why It Matters |
|---|---|
| Cross-training | Everyone can cover for each other |
| Fewer production incidents | Less time firefighting |
| Faster onboarding | New members learn patterns quickly |

## Key Considerations
- Keep reviews **focused and timely** to avoid bottlenecks
- Use a **lightweight process** — small teams don't need heavy bureaucracy
- Pair with **automated tools** (linters, CI/CD) to handle routine checks

---

**Bottom line:** For small teams, code review is one of the highest-value practices available — improving quality *and* resilience without requiring significant overhead.
Code review helps small teams catch bugs early, share knowledge, and maintain a consistent, high-quality codebase.

1. **Bug detection** — Reviewers catch errors and oversights before code reaches production.
2. **Knowledge sharing** — Team members stay familiar with each other's work, reducing dependence on any single person.
Code review fosters a **culture of shared ownership**, where everyone feels responsible for the quality of the codebase rather than treating code as one person's isolated work.

user_text: State one risk if reviews are skipped.
assistant_text: If reviews are skipped, **knowledge silos** can form, leaving the team vulnerable when a key developer is unavailable or leaves.
Track **defect escape rate** — the number of bugs found in production versus those caught during review — to measure how effectively code reviews are preventing issues from reaching users.
Even a lightweight review process can significantly improve code quality and team resilience over time.

• Code review catches bugs early and improves quality
• It spreads knowledge across the team
• It builds shared ownership and accountability
• Even a simple process delivers significant long-term benefits
• Code review is a simple, high-value practice that keeps small teams aligned, informed, and shipping better software.
• Code review is only effective if feedback is timely and constructive — slow or overly critical reviews can bottleneck progress and harm team morale.
• Timely, constructive reviews help teams; slow or harsh ones hurt.
• Code review improves quality, shares knowledge, and strengthens small teams — keep it simple and constructive.
